content.text: The assignment provisions meet the preferred position in full.

input.quote: 24.1 Customer may assign this Agreement or an Order Form without Vendor's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all assets or business to which the Agreement relates.
input.rationale: Section 24 meets our preferred position on every material term. 24.1 gives Customer a consent-free affiliate/successor (M&A and asset-sale) carve-out, subject only to prompt notice and assignee assumption. 24.2 restricts Vendor assignment, delegation of material performance and change-of-control transfers to Customer's prior written consent (not unreasonably withheld for a capable, financially sound assignee) and bars assignment to a direct Customer competitor. 24.4 expressly denies Vendor any right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees or reduce service on Customer's change of control. 24.3's catch-all is expressly limited to "other assignments" and so does not undercut the 24.1 carve-out, and 13.3 carries the licence rights across a permitted assignment. No Vendor exit or re-pricing trigger appears elsewhere in the document (9.2 is an ordinary insolvency clause that expressly excludes lawful reorganizations). No redline needed.
